steps.note: Open the prepared upcoming RFQ on its buyer-side summary page.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration for the upcoming RFQ.
Open the Reschedule Event dialog from the event settings.
Verify that the rescheduling pop-up is open.
Change the proposed start time but deliberately leave the dialog unconfirmed so Cancel can be pressed.
Cancel the changed rescheduling values instead of saving them.
Verify that cancelling closes the rescheduling dialog.
Verify that the buyer remains on the event summary rather than navigating to a saved rescheduled state.
Confirm that cancellation did not produce an error or page failure.
